training_items.reason: Wet litter plus observed hock lesions gives a coherent higher-concern contrast against dry litter without those observed lesions.
training_items.evidence_scope: EFSA identifies poor litter quality as a hock-burn hazard and hock burns as painful lesions.
training_items.remaining_confound_or_limit: The pair changes litter and observed injury together, so it tests the combined stated condition. Lack of hock lesions is not absence of all harm.

training_items.reason: Retain the relative label conditional on the explicit hypothetical assumption of effective insensibility without recovery before death.
training_items.evidence_scope: No new source establishes a particular effective Western rock lobster stunning method; this is a stipulated state, not a verified procedure.
training_items.remaining_confound_or_limit: Do not reintroduce a claim that an unspecified electrical device is effective or that live tailing is common in this fishery. Explicit words responsive/insensible may themselves be lexical cues.

training_items.reason: Retain because respiratory distress is explicitly stated, not inferred from stocking density or low oxygen alone.
training_items.evidence_scope: The original African-catfish study emphasizes low-oxygen tolerance and context-dependent density effects. It does not validate the fictional distressed tank.
training_items.remaining_confound_or_limit: This air-breathing species should not be labelled distressed merely from low dissolved oxygen. The prompt stipulates distress; no numeric oxygen threshold or welfare-free status is inferred.

training_items.reason: Retain lower concern for shorter exposure under the counterfactual matched-condition assumption.
training_items.evidence_scope: EFSA describes continuing transport stressors and recommends minimizing journey duration.
training_items.remaining_confound_or_limit: 24 hours versus 90 minutes also supplies a general duration/efficiency cue. Other journey conditions must remain matched in the design; this is not an actual verified supply chain.

training_items.reason: Retain relative movement and nesting/perching opportunity label; rename substantive construct to housing restriction in analysis.
training_items.evidence_scope: EFSA discusses restriction of movement/behaviour and recommends spacious enriched housing with elevated structures.
training_items.remaining_confound_or_limit: Historical item ID says welfare_claims_labels, but revised treatment is housing, not certification. Cages versus indoor housing is a bundle of related conditions; no completely safe egg label.

training_items.reason: Retain a relative turtle-entrapment-risk label given correct installation/maintenance and otherwise fixed fishing context.
training_items.evidence_scope: NOAA describes TED escape openings and effective turtle exclusion when installed and maintained properly.
training_items.remaining_confound_or_limit: This measures relative risk, not observed harm in every trip. Other bycatch and shrimp welfare remain; TEDs can also improve catch quality, so factual matching must be kept explicit in experiment interpretation.

rules: Existing six user approvals concern exact source texts and relative treatment labels. They are not silently transferred to rewritten descriptions.
No whole-option safe/unsafe or internal-evaluation-present/absent labels are created.
The same treatment sentence must occur under welfare/factual goals and both administrative qualities. Administrative quality must vary independently of treatment concern.
Price and order changes must be applied consistently in rendered metadata/search/detail records; remove same-price/service claims from new prose.
All new full inputs require fresh activations. Old training states remain useful baselines/comparators, not substitutes for changed prefixes.
Administrative controls are deliberately non-animal but not matched to distress intensity. Their success does not prove welfare-specific evaluation.
Exact training-control sentences do not occur in the reserved v7 draft; broader document-formatting/clerical-quality themes do overlap.
Two training styles are fixed per item, not a new style factor. No claim of broad style robustness follows.
Factual-reading instruction does not establish absence of evaluation; no model-answer or probe score can be used to silently relabel examples.
A prospective run is not authorized by this file. No model or tokenizer run was performed.
